scope: Theorem 17.9 (Finite description of a minimum example) of the manuscript “Finite congruence lattices: characterization and undecidability” (preprints/Finite-Congruence-Lattices-Characterization-and-Undecidability-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 206 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d26d6cd6285de4f2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 176. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The bounded formulas (17.13)–(17.16), with the ordinary unevaluated Busy Beaver constant (17.1), specify the full finite order table of a nonrepresentable lattice L0 of minimum cardinality. Its cardinality is the integer a0 in (17.15), and 7 < a0 ≤ M∗. This is a finite order description and a proof of minimum cardinality; it does not supply a numerically evaluated value of that cardinality.
